records.failureSummary:
Implemented and exported computeColumnWidths(table, convert = toInlineCell) from src/render.mjs, the only backend file changed. Semantics: for every column (including the last) width = max(3, max converted display length over the header cell plus all data-row cells of that column); when rows is empty widths derive from headers only; widths are computed from the converter output (FR-2 order: newline ->
, | -> backslash-pipe, trim) and missing/non-array row cells count as empty, so they never raise a width. Trust-boundary input is validated defensively (null/undefined table, missing or non-array headers, non-array rows) and a non-function convert falls back to toInlineCell, so nothing throws. Evidence: node --test test/render.width.test.mjs is 7/7 green ([AC-03] width cases); test/render.cell.test.mjs [AC-02] 6/6 green and test/parse.test.mjs green, so no T-03/T-04 regression; npm run build and npm run lint both exit 0; full npm run test is 20/21 pass. The single remaining failure is not in this task's code: test/render.padright.test.mjs line 27 asserts padRight(\"ab\",5).trimStart().length === 2, which is unsatisfiable because line 24 already requires the right-padded string \"ab \" (trimStart removes no leading whitespace, so length is 5). It lives in a QA-owned test file outside my backend write scope, so I did not modify it; no change in src/render.mjs can satisfy that assertion.
